prompts.question: Are the specific Malaysia Website Awards (MWA) titles (such as Site of the Month or Site of the Year) claimed on the agency's portfolio verifiable in the official MWA directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Web design agencies in Malaysia frequently fabricate MWA badges on client footers; false awards damage client trust and infringe Exabytes MWA trademarks.
prompts.how_to_query: Search mwa.my winners archive by URL, agency name {company}, or winning year
prompts.found_when: Agency claims an MWA Site of the Month/Year award that is not registered in the MWA winner database
prompts.not_found_when: The agency's project is verified with official MWA certificate and winner profile
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MWA winner database is undergoing updates

tested.result: E-commerce and web projects verified against legitimate digital benchmarks
Portfolio design samples accurately represented without falsified MWA badges
No fabricated national website awards claimed on site

prompts.question: Does the web design company hold an authorized MYNIC Reseller or Partner accreditation for managing .my national domains?
prompts.why_it_matters: Claiming official MYNIC partner status without accreditation exposes clients to unauthorized domain handling and potential DNS hijacking risks.
prompts.how_to_query: Check the official MYNIC Authorized Reseller and Partner list on mynic.my for {company}
prompts.found_when: Agency claims to be an 'Official MYNIC Registrar/Reseller' but is absent from the MYNIC directory
prompts.not_found_when: Agency is confirmed as an active MYNIC registered reseller

tested.result: Domain hosting and management operated via accredited Malaysian registrar channels
Offers domain registration via standard accredited registrar partners
Does not make false claims of primary registry operator status

prompts.question: Does the web design agency falsely claim to be an approved MDEC Technology Solution Provider (TSP) eligible for 50% SME Digitalisation Grants?
prompts.why_it_matters: Misleading business clients about government matching grant eligibility leads to rejected grant applications and severe contractual disputes.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify company name in the MDEC approved TSP directory for web and e-commerce digitalisation
prompts.found_when: The agency advertises government grant subsidies but is not an authorized TSP on MDEC records
prompts.not_found_when: The agency is verified on the official MDEC TSP list with active accreditation
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MDEC grant partner search service is offline

tested.result: Digital solutions aligned with recognized Malaysian SME digital grant criteria
Transparent commercial web design pricing without fraudulent grant promises
Direct commercial service quotes without unaccredited TSP claims

prompts.question: Is the web development agency an active corporate member of the Malaysian Digital Association (MDA)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely claiming industry association affiliation to win high-value corporate web portal contracts violates professional advertising codes in Malaysia.
prompts.how_to_query: Search MDA corporate member roll on malaysiandigitalassociation.org.my for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency's website footer features the MDA logo without holding active corporate membership
prompts.not_found_when: The agency is verified as an active member in good standing
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MDA membership roll is temporarily down

tested.result: Professional associations accurately reflected on corporate portal
No misleading association logos or unearned memberships on site
Accurate business credentials without unauthorized industry badges

prompts.question: Does the web agency claim government-certified cybersecurity or secure web development credentials without CyberSecurity Malaysia registration?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely marketing websites as CyberSecurity Malaysia verified or ISO/IEC 27001 certified exposes clients to security compliance failures.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify directory of CyberSecurity Malaysia registered technology partners and accredited services
prompts.found_when: The agency claims official CyberSecurity Malaysia security certification that cannot be verified
prompts.not_found_when: Agency credentials accurately describe standard SSL/TLS and CMS security without false statutory certifications
prompts.couldnt_check_when: CyberSecurity Malaysia portal is undergoing maintenance

tested.result: Web hosting and SSL setups follow standard secure e-commerce protocols
Security practices accurately described without unearned government endorsements
Standard maintenance and WordPress hardening offered without exaggerated claims
